name: Starry Bus Theme
description: Starry Bus glassmorphic theme pack for PI-Desktop with automatic OS light/dark theme switching between Starry Bus Night and Starry Bus Day.
safetyNotes: Registers themes and a panel. Runs fixed read-only OS appearance queries using reg.exe on Windows, defaults on macOS, or gsettings on Linux every four seconds in Auto mode. Reads bundled assets and writes only plugin-owned data. No network or credential access.

en.name: Starry Bus Theme
en.description: Starry Bus glassmorphic theme pack for PI-Desktop inspired by the starry clouds, retro bus, and sunlit meadow illustration, with automatic OS light/dark mode switching.
en.safetyNotes: Registers themes and a panel. Runs fixed read-only OS appearance queries using reg.exe on Windows, defaults on macOS, or gsettings on Linux every four seconds in Auto mode. Reads bundled assets and writes only plugin-owned data. No network or credential access.

zh-CN.name: 星夜巴士主题
zh-CN.description: 灵感源自星夜积雨云、复古大众小巴士与阳光草坡插画的 PI-Desktop 毛玻璃主题包，支持根据操作系统深浅色自动切换「夜空版」与「云昼版」。
zh-CN.safetyNotes: 注册主题和面板；自动模式每四秒运行固定的只读系统外观查询（Windows reg.exe、macOS defaults、Linux gsettings）。读取随包资源，仅写入插件自身数据目录，不访问网络或凭据。
